LanguageData.PharnaStrength.label: Strength
LanguageData.PharnaStrength.description: Increases melee damage factor, sharp/blunt armor penetration, and carrying capacity.
LanguageData.PharnaEndurance.label: Endurance
LanguageData.PharnaEndurance.description: Increases sharp/blunt/heat armor, healing factor. Reduces damage taken, stagger duration, pain shock threshold, and rest rate fall.
LanguageData.PharnaDexterity.label: Dexterity
LanguageData.PharnaDexterity.description: Increases global work speed, shooting accuracy. Reduces melee cooldown, aiming time, and ranged cooldown.
LanguageData.PharnaAgility.label: Agility
LanguageData.PharnaAgility.description: Increases movement speed, melee dodge, and ranged dodge.
LanguageData.PharnaMana.label: Magic
LanguageData.PharnaMana.description: Increases psychic entropy threshold, meditation psyfocus gain, and spell power.
LanguageData.PharnaWill.label: Will
LanguageData.PharnaWill.description: Increases virtue trigger chance and reduces virtue cooldown.
LanguageData.PharnaExperience.label: Experience
LanguageData.PharnaExperience.description: Total experience gained through daily practice and learning. Each ability point gained also grants 1 experience.
LanguageData.PharnaExploits.label: Exploits
LanguageData.PharnaExploits.description: Exploits earned by completing expeditions and guild quests. Reach 999 to ascend the Blessing level.
